background: Investec plc is the UK-listed half of the dual-listed Anglo-South African Investec group, a specialist bank and wealth manager funded by UK deposits and lending to mid-sized companies, professionals and high-net-worth clients.
synthesis: Only one of the three main agencies rates the group, at A- on a positive outlook, after a one-notch upgrade on 14 Apr 2026 and a move to positive outlook on 25 Aug 2026. Liquidity is the strength, with LCR of 354% in the top quarter of UK mid-sized banks and NSFR of 140% at the median, and leverage of 8.9% is in the top quarter too. CET1 of 12.7% is in the bottom quarter. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 has risen 0.5 points while LCR has fallen 83 points and NSFR 8 points (figures to 30 Jun 2026).
